## Pull request overview

Upgrades the monorepo’s ObjectStack integration by bumping all `@objectstack/*` dependencies to v3.3.0 (with `@objectstack/plugin-audit` pinned at its latest v3.2.10), and updates repo docs to reflect the new versions.

**Changes:**
- Bumped `@objectstack/*` dependency ranges from `^3.2.9` → `^3.3.0` across 13 `package.json` files.
- Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml` to resolve the updated `@objectstack/*` graph at v3.3.0.
- Updated `CHANGELOG.md` and `ROADMAP.md` version references.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 15 out of 16 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ROADMAP.md | Updates referenced ObjectStack spec/client versions and last-updated date. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Adds an Unreleased entry describing the monorepo-wide ObjectStack upgrade. |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Lockfile regen to resolve `@objectstack/*` packages at v3.3.0 (and `plugin-audit` at v3.2.10). |
| package.json | Bumps root `@objectstack/*` devDependencies/dependencies to `^3.3.0`. |
| apps/console/package.json | Bumps console ObjectStack dependencies to `^3.3.0`. |
| examples/crm/package.json | Bumps CRM example ObjectStack dependencies to `^3.3.0`. |

| examples/msw-todo/package.json | Bumps MSW Todo example ObjectStack dependencies to `^3.3.0`. |
| examples/kitchen-sink/package.json | Bumps Kitchen Sink example `@objectstack/spec`/CLI to `^3.3.0`. |
| packages/core/package.json | Bumps `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.3.0`. |
| packages/types/package.json | Bumps `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.3.0`. |
| packages/react/package.json | Bumps `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.3.0`. |
| packages/data-objectstack/package.json | Bumps `@objectstack/client` to `^3.3.0`. |
| packages/plugin-map/package.json | Bumps `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.3.0`. |
| packages/plugin-gantt/package.json | Bumps `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.3.0`. |
| packages/plugin-timeline/package.json | Bumps `@objectstack/spec` to `^3.3.0`. |
</details>

<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

ROADMAP header now states @objectstack/spec/@objectstack/client v3.3.0, but the document still contains a later section titled “Spec v3.0.9 Upgrade Summary” (and related text) which reads like the current spec upgrade summary. Consider updating/renaming that section (or adding a new v3.3.0 summary) so the roadmap doesn’t appear internally inconsistent after this version bump.

This changelog entry hard-codes exact build/test counts (“42 build tasks” / “7,224 tests”). Those numbers will drift over time and make the entry look incorrect even if the upgrade remains valid. Suggest rephrasing to a stable statement (e.g., build + test suite passing) without embedding specific counts.
```suggestion
- **Upgrade @objectstack packages from v3.2.9 to v3.3.0**: Upgraded all `@objectstack/*` dependencies across the entire monorepo (root, `apps/console`, `examples/crm`, `examples/todo`, `examples/msw-todo`, `examples/kitchen-sink`, `packages/core`, `packages/types`, `packages/react`, `packages/data-objectstack`, `packages/plugin-map`, `packages/plugin-gantt`, `packages/plugin-timeline`) from `^3.2.9` to `^3.3.0`. All build tasks and test suites pass with no breaking changes.
```
